tool_args.rationale: The pilot samples only up to s_grad = 1.38, overlapping the proposed critical range of 1.3–1.5. A high-gradient probe directly tests the possible supercritical avalanche and identifies its parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub base law without an avalanche term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot ends at s_grad = 1.38, so it cannot identify whether an avalanche onset occurs above the observed range.
The unresolved question is the response at higher sink gradients, not trajectory resolution.
It does not target the identified ambiguity.
